FACTUAL_FINDING: 4 solver calls per MPC cycle (Stage 1 -> Stage 2 -> Stage 3 -> Stage 4)
Minimizes unserved critical demand energy shortfall E_crit_shortfall(t)
Captures scalar optimal objective value J1* upon solver termination
Constructs linear inequality constraint J1(x) <= J1* + eps1
Minimizes EBR reserve shortfall E_EBR_shortfall(t) subject to Stage 1 lock constraint
Captures scalar optimal objective value J2* upon Stage 2 termination
Constructs linear inequality constraint J2(x) <= J2* + eps2
Minimizes diesel fuel consumption V_diesel(t) subject to Stage 1 and Stage 2 lock constraints
Captures scalar optimal objective value J3* upon Stage 3 termination
Minimizes avoidable renewable curtailment E_curtail_avoidable(t) subject to Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3 lock constraints
Extracts optimal decision vector x* from Stage 4 solve to construct DispatchPlan
Detect and record failure; operational response REQUIRES_GOVERNANCE_DECISION
Records intermediate values (J1*, J2*, J3*, J4*) in DispatchPlan diagnostic metadata
Logs stage status, iteration counts, and objective values in execution provenance manifest
Deterministic replay within authorized numerical and structural replay tolerances
Restore previously authorized optimizer implementation without external environment changes
